name: TRUTH App — Protected Table Snapshot to Drive
description: Polls snapshot queue every 10 min. Saves change records from protected tables to Drive as .md files. Guards drift_guards, framework_rules, tensions_wall, kb_sights, kb_conclusions. ASK 228: a file Drive refuses is sent again after 62 s; if refused twice its rows go back to pending and the run errors. rev 3: a refused file whose name is already in the folder is not sent or re-queued.

parameters.errorMessage: ={{ 'PROTECTED SNAPSHOT: Drive refused ' + $('Confirm Unsaved Rows').first().json.files.join(', ') + ' twice, 62 s apart, and the name search did not find them (' + $('Confirm Unsaved Rows').first().json.error + '). Re-queued ' + $('Re-queue Unsaved Rows').all().filter(i => i.json && i.json.id).length + ' of ' + $('Confirm Unsaved Rows').first().json.ids.length + ' queue rows as pending for the next run.' }}

parameters.queryString: ={{ "'1r2expT2tdtkutuc0hmCdqrA8r2g3n-AO' in parents and (" + $('Wait Out Drive Quota').all().map(i => i.json.filename).map(f => "name = '" + String(f).replace(/['\\]/g, c => '\\' + c) + "'").join(' or ') + ")" }}
={{ "'1r2expT2tdtkutuc0hmCdqrA8r2g3n-AO' in parents and (" + $json.lost.map(b => b.filename).map(f => "name = '" + String(f).replace(/['\\]/g, c => '\\' + c) + "'").join(' or ') + ")" }}

parameters.jsCode:
const built = $('Build Snapshot Content').all().map(x => x.json);
return [{ json: { status: 'snapshot_saved', tables: built.map(b => b.table_name), files: built.map(b => b.filename), saved: $input.all().length, ts: new Date().toISOString() } }];
